name: Flamewing Kael
description: A dragon-touched warrior who wields a blazing greatsword. Excels at frontline damage and breaking enemy formation.

name: Seraphina Iceveil
description: A frost mage who draws power from ancient glacial dragons. Her spells slow and freeze entire battlefields.

name: Zephyr Nightwhisper
description: A shadowy rogue who stalks the night. Specializes in backline assassinations and poisons.

name: Caelum Stormshot
description: A sharpshooter blessed by sky dragons. Her arrows carry the force of gale winds.

name: Lunara Dawnwell
description: A priestess who channels the light of creation dragons. Her healing and cleansing abilities keep allies fighting.

name: Ignis Emberclaw
description: A novice dragon tamer who fights alongside her fire drake. Reliable and easy to raise.

name: Tidecaller Mara
description: A coastal mage who communes with sea serpents. Her tidal magic provides excellent area control.
